distractors.reason: 'Deeply' is used with feelings and emotions (deeply moved, deeply sad). We don't say 'deeply funny'.
'Highly' is used with formal qualities and praise (highly skilled, highly recommended). We don't normally say 'highly funny' about a comic strip.
'Fully' means 'completely' (fully booked, fully charged). It doesn't describe how funny something is.

l1_interference: Українці можуть подумати, що 'highly' потрібно для будь-якої сильної якості, бо в українській мові 'високий' часто означає сильний. Тому можна сказати 'highly funny' замість 'very funny'. Запам'ятайте: 'very' використовується для звичайних якостей, а 'highly' для формальної похвали.
explanation: In English, 'very' is the most common degree adverb for everyday adjectives like funny, big, or happy. 'Highly' and 'deeply' have special meanings, so they don't fit this collocation.

related_collocations.example: This comic strip is very good.
I feel very happy when I read comics.
That last panel is really funny.

memory_tip: VERY = everyday adjectives (very funny, very big) | HIGHLY = formal praise (highly skilled, highly recommended)
